def main(argv: List[str], stdout: IO[str], stderr: IO[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="MonkeyType CLI")
    parser.add_argument(
        "-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", help="Verbose output"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "-c",
        "--config",
        type=get_monkeytype_config,
        help="Config instance in the form module:qualname or module:qualname()",
    )
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", help="Available commands")
    
    # stub command
    stub_parser = subparsers.add_parser("stub", help="Generate stubs")
    stub_parser.add_argument("module_path", type=module_path, help="Module path")
    stub_parser.add_argument(
        "--ignore-existing-annotations",
        action="store_true",
        help="Ignore existing annotations",
    )
    stub_parser.add_argument("--diff", action="store_true", help="Show diff")
    stub_parser.add_argument(
        "--sample-count", action="store_true", help="Display sample count"
    )
    stub_parser.add_argument(
        "--limit", type=int, default=None, help="Limit number of traces"
    )
    stub_parser.add_argument(
        "--disable-type-rewriting",
        action="store_true",
        help="Disable type rewriting",
    )
    stub_parser.add_argument(
        "--pep-563",
        action="store_true",
        help="Use PEP 563 style annotations",
    )
    
    # apply command
    apply_parser = subparsers.add_parser("apply", help="Apply stubs")
    apply_parser.add_argument("module_path", type=module_path, help="Module path")
    apply_parser.add_argument(
        "--ignore-existing-annotations",
        action="store_true",
        help="Ignore existing annotations",
    )
    apply_parser.add_argument(
        "--limit", type=int, default=None, help="Limit number of traces"
    )
    apply_parser.add_argument(
        "--disable-type-rewriting",
        action="store_true",
        help="Disable type rewriting",
    )
    apply_parser.add_argument(
        "--pep-563",
        action="store_true",
        help="Use PEP 563 style annotations",
    )
    
    # list-modules command
    list_modules_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "list-modules", help="List modules with traces"
    )
    
    # run command
    run_parser = subparsers.add_parser("run", help="Run with tracing")
    run_parser.add_argument("script_path", help="Script path")
    run_parser.add_argument("script_args", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER, help="Script args")
    run_parser.add_argument("-m", action="store_true", help="Run as module")
    
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    args.verbose = args.verbose if hasattr(args, "verbose") else False
    
    # Load config
    if hasattr(args, "config") and args.config:
        args.config = args.config
    else:
        args.config = Config()
    
    # Set default values from config
    if hasattr(args, "limit"):
        update_args_from_config(args)
    
    # Set existing annotation strategy
    if hasattr(args, "ignore_existing_annotations"):
        if args.ignore_existing_annotations:
            args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.IGNORE
        else:
            args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
    else:
        args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
    
    # Get context manager if available
    context_manager = None
    try:
        context_manager = args.config.context_manager(args.command or "")
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    try:
        if context_manager:
            with context_manager:
                if args.command == "stub":
                    print_stub_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
                elif args.command == "apply":
                    apply_stub_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
                elif args.command == "list-modules":
                    list_modules_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
                elif args.command == "run":
                    run_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
                else:
                    parser.print_help(stderr)
                    return 1
        else:
            if args.command == "stub":
                print_stub_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
            elif args.command == "apply":
                apply_stub_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
            elif args.command == "list-modules":
                list_modules_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
            elif args.command == "run":
                run_handler(args, stdout, stderr)
            else:
                parser.print_help(stderr)
                return 1
    except HandlerError as e:
        print(str(e), file=stderr)
        return 1
    
    return 0
